patch.content:
menu "ZBUS - Zephyr Bus"

config ZBUS
	bool "Enable ZBUS"
	default y
	help
	  Enable the Zephyr Bus subsystem.

if ZBUS

config ZBUS_SINGLE_THREADED
	bool "Enable ZBUS single-threaded mode"
	depends on !MULTITHREADING
	help
	  Enable ZBUS single-threaded mode.
	  This mode removes mutexes and semaphores from ZBUS,
	  making it suitable for single-threaded environments.

config ZBUS_MSG_SUBSCRIBER
	bool "Enable ZBUS message subscriber API"
	default y
	help
	  Enable the ZBUS message subscriber API.
	  This allows observers to subscribe to specific message types.

config ZBUS_CHAN_SUBSCRIBER
	bool "Enable ZBUS channel subscriber API"
	default y
	help
	  Enable the ZBUS channel subscriber API.
	  This allows observers to subscribe to specific channels.

config ZBUS_OBSERVER_MESSAGE_FIFO
	bool "Enable ZBUS observer message FIFO"
	default y
	help
	  Enable a message FIFO for ZBUS observers.
	  This allows observers to receive messages via a FIFO instead of direct callback.

config ZBUS_LOG_LEVEL
	int "ZBUS log level"
	default 0
	range 0 4
	help
	  Set the log level for ZBUS.
	  0: No logging
	  1: Error
	  2: Warning
	  3: Info
	  4: Debug

endif # ZBUS

endmenu
